We multiply each row in the matrix by the column vector using the dot product:

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 1 \\ -2 & 2 & -2 \\ 1 & -2 & 1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-2 \\ -1 \\ 3\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}1\cdot (-2)+(-2)\cdot (-1)+1\cdot 3 \\ (-2)\cdot (-2)+2\cdot (-1)+(-2)\cdot 3 \\ 1\cdot (-2)+(-2)\cdot (-1)+1\cdot 3\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-2+2+3 \\ 4-2-6 \\ -2+2+3\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}3 \\ -4 \\ 3\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$
